provider.name: IUCN Green List of Protected and Conserved Areas
provider.organization_type: global protected-and-conserved-area quality standard, certification, assessment, assurance, governance, monitoring, site-directory, and capacity-building programme
provider.description: The IUCN Green List of Protected and Conserved Areas is a global standard and certification programme for equitable governance, sound design and planning, effective management, and successful conservation outcomes. It supports protected and conserved areas through applications, jurisdictional indicator adaptation, expert assessment groups, independent assurance, certification, renewal, public site profiles, training, reporting, and integration with IUCN and Protected Planet standards.
institutional_context: International Union for Conservation of Nature
IUCN World Commission on Protected Areas
Participating governments, protected and conserved area authorities, and rights holders

notes: Verify whether the Green List provides a supported public API or only public web pages, maps, downloads, and an authenticated application portal.
Do not infer undocumented portal or administrative endpoints from browser traffic.
Separate public certification data from confidential application, evidence, stakeholder, and assurance records.
Do not store credentials, API keys, cookies, OAuth tokens, or session identifiers in this manifest.
Capture exact IUCN, Green List, site owner, jurisdiction, Protected Planet, donor, photographer, and third-party legal wording.
Separate public site profiles from confidential applications, evidence, stakeholder information, assessments, reviews, and appeals.
Preserve site ID, certificate ID, standard version, source, access date, license URI, rights holder, attribution, and confidentiality status.
Do not assume public certification status grants access to confidential evidence or unrestricted use of maps, photos, or partner data.
Seed URLs are best-effort and were not live-verified in this session.
The acquisition program should update retrieval, content, review, and verification fields in place.
Green List website routes, portal URLs, API paths, country pages, site profiles, standard documents, and assurance arrangements may change; preserve redirect and failure metadata.
Do not recursively crawl every site, country, evidence file, portal record, assessment, reviewer report, or API result when the task is documentation acquisition.
Do not store credentials, passwords, API keys, cookies, tokens, confidential evidence, personal data, or session identifiers in this JSON file.

Public site records, standards, maps, photographs, Protected Planet data, application evidence, assessments, reviews, stakeholder information, and software may carry different rights and confidentiality restrictions.

Always preserve site ID, site name, country, jurisdiction, designation, area, geometry status, WDPA ID, IUCN category, governance type, application status, standard version, indicators, certification ID, decision date, expiry, renewal, source URL, citation, confidentiality, and provenance.
